title: The U.S. Mobile Network Industrial Base: An Assessment and U.S. Government Action Plan
summary_en: This assessment of the U.S. mobile network industrial base identifies a strategy to leverage U.S. strengths to build an advanced 6G ecosystem by establishing a public-private partnership between the U.S. government and the private sector.
title_cn: The U.S. Mobile Network Industrial Base: An Assessment and U.S. Government Action Plan
